data.name: Awmari
data.gender_notes: Awmari is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Awmari is a name derived from the Arabic word 'awmar', which means 'plentiful' or 'abundant'. It is a name that signifies a life full of blessings and resources. The name Awmari carries the meaning “Plentiful, Abundant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awmari usually hope their child will grow to embody plentiful, abundant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Awmari is a name that carries the spiritual meaning of abundance and provision from Allah (SWT). It is a reminder of the blessings that Allah bestows upon us and a call to be grateful and thankful for them.
data.etymology: Awmari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Plentiful, Abundant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awmari total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
